title: Critically injured civil defense worker arrives at Al-Shifa Hospital after 'Israeli' airstrike
description:
A critically injured member of Gaza’s Civil Defense teams arrived at Al-Shifa Hospital in western Gaza City after being wounded in an 'Israeli' airstrike near Abu Sharkh Roundabout in northern Gaza.
